## Why this layout

| Top-level | Responsibility | Why it is separate |
|---|---|---|
| `src/ppe/` | Importable library: data, training, evaluation, tracking, rules, export | One tested codebase shared by research notebooks and production services |
| `services/` | Deployable processes (API, stream worker, inference, alert worker, dashboard) | Each scales, fails and deploys independently; each has its own Dockerfile |
| `configs/` | YAML for data, training, eval, serving, environments | Behavior changes without code changes; every run reproducible from a file |
| `pipelines/` | Orchestrated flows (retrain, refresh, drift check) | Continuous training lives apart from library code |
| `monitoring/` | Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OTel config | Observability as code |
| `infra/`, `deploy/` | Terraform and Kubernetes manifests | Infrastructure as code, reviewed like code |
| `docker/` | Compose files and base images | Local-to-cloud parity |
| `tests/` | unit, data, model, integration, load | Matches the ML testing pyramid |
| `docs/` | PRD, design, ADRs, runbooks, theory notes | Decisions and teaching notes live with the code |
